name: focus-break
description: A calm, private focus timer with mindful breaks. No account, no tracking.

scripts.build:windows: npm run build && npm run icons && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && npm run icons && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && node scripts/capacitor.mjs sync android
scripts.check: node --check src/app.js && node --check src/core.js && node --check src/platform.js && node --check shared/state-codec.js && node --check shared/state-journal.js && node --check desktop/state-store.cjs && node --check desktop/data-location.cjs && node --check desktop/main.cjs && node --check desktop/preload.cjs

author: Focus Break contributors
